messages:
acme-dev: Hi—over the last 24h some API calls from our service are getting routed to the EU edge. latency spikes from ~40ms to ~320ms. No config changes on our side. Any idea?

Maria (Support): Sorry to hear that. Can you paste a minimal curl with headers and a sample request-id? Also which SDK/version?

acme-dev: curl we use:
```
curl -v -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...\" -H \"X-Client-Region:\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate\" \\
  -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
```
request-id: req_2026-03-16-99e2
SDK: our in-house wrapper v2.3.1 (calls the REST endpoint directly)

Maria (Support): Thanks — I see the X-Client-Region header is present but empty. Quick check: are you also sending ?region= or a JSON field?

acme-dev: we sometimes add ?region= when region detection fails but in this case it was omitted. Noticed the router logs for req_2026-03-16-99e2 show \"route=europe-west-1\" though the client is US.

Jon (eng-sre): @Maria adding context: router treats empty X-Client-Region header as \"present but empty\" and our precedence logic currently prefers header over query param. If header exists (even empty) we parse; empty string falls back to the global default region which for some tenants is set to EU for compliance reasons — that explains the EU route.

Maria (Support): Repro steps (internal):
1) curl with -H \"X-Client-Region:\" (blank)
2) hits edge -> header considered present -> parsed as empty -> router fallback -> picks tenant default region (EU)

Lee (Platform): Quick mitigation: our edge can treat empty header as absent with a routing ACL. I can push a short-lived rule to ignore blank X-Client-Region for that tenant. Would you like that while we fix parsing?

acme-dev: yes please, that would prevent the cross-region latency. Also surprised this changed without us adjusting anything.

Jon (eng-sre): Root cause: recent header-parsing change (PR #4521) tightened header existence checks to prefer explicit header presence. It didn't special-case empty values. Escalating to eng-runtime for a fix and creating a routing ACL for the tenant.

Maria (Support): Filed support ticket S-10823 and linked request-id req_2026-03-16-99e2. Proposed steps:
- Temporary: platform ACL to ignore blank X-Client-Region for tenant acme-corp (Lee)
- Medium: SDK guidance to trim empty headers before sending (acme-dev)
- Long: runtime change to treat empty region header as absent and fallback to query / default policy (Jon -> eng-runtime)

Jon (eng-sre): Patch in progress. For diagnostics, can you paste raw request headers from your proxy (including any trailing spaces/newlines)? We saw a variant that had a zero-width space \u200B which made header non-empty in earlier incidents.

acme-dev: pasted raw headers:
```
Host: api.redwood.ai
Authorization: Bearer sk_live_...
X-Client-Region: \nUser-Agent: acme-service/2.3.1
```
No hidden chars on our end.

Lee (Platform): I've created ACL rule RB-329 to ignore blank X-Client-Region for tenant id acme-123; deploying now. deploy-bot: starting rollout.

deploy-bot: Rollout RB-329 started by Lee (Platform). Canary -> 5%. Logs: no errors.

Maria (Support): Can you confirm after a few minutes whether new requests land in US and latency returns to normal?

acme-dev: confirming—after ~2 minutes new calls show 42ms and route US-west. Thanks.

Jon (eng-sre): I'll follow up with a runtime patch to change precedence: ignore empty header values and prefer query param or tenant default only if header absent. PR target: next patch release.

acme-dev: Appreciate the fast help. Any billing impact from cross-region routing? We had a spike in token-processing time and noticed a few unexpected billable ops.

Maria (Support): We'll review billing for the window (ticket S-10823) and flag anything unusually charged due to EU routing. If there was a measurable delta we'll propose a credit.

Jon (eng-sre): Adding notes to incident: suspect header-empty parsing + tenant default region -> EU route. Action items assigned: Jon (runtime patch), Lee (ACL + monitor), Maria (billing review + customer comms).

acme-dev: good plan. Please link PR and ticket when available.

Maria (Support): will do. Closing thread once runtime patch is merged and billing reviewed. :thumbsup:
